page: Microsoft Azure EC16eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features an Intel processor with 16 dedicated vCPUs. The instance is allocated 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. Virtualization is managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server type includes 945 GB of local NVMe SSD storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard graphics processing units, as the GPU count is zero.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the EC16eds_v6 offers a high density of memory relative to compute resources, bundled with fast local NVMe storage, which reduces the need for external storage attachments for temporary data. This hardware profile is designed for memory-intensive workloads, database management systems, in-memory caching, and enterprise applications that require substantial memory capacity and fast local scratch space.
